A dozen of us shot at him and he waved that lightsaber back and forth and ''blocked'' the bolts!|Darth Vader and the Barabel bounty hunter|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Barabel bounty hunter''' was among a combined group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] under the leadership of the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Skahtul]] who captured the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]] with the intention of cashing in on his [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] placed by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Skywalker soon escaped, however, and when Vader arrived on Kothlis to collect the captured Skywalker, he angrily interrogated the Barabel bounty hunter, the highest-ranking survivor of his group.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Shadows of the Empire 5|''Shadows of the Empire'' 5]] depicts and establishes this character as a Barabel. However, the [[1996 Topps Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|''Shadows of the Empire'' trading card set]] depicts this character as a [[Human/Legends|Human]] wearing an [[Armor/Legends|armored]] suit.
